reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a chain link crossed out by a diagonal slash, the standard symbol for removing a hyperlink, fixing broken links, or unlinking connected accounts. While somewhat specialized to digital admin and web maintenance, it maps directly to common tasks like fixing 404 URLs and disconnecting third-party app or bank integrations. At tiny sizes the parallel diagonal lines of the link and the slash can merge visually.
